localized.zh_cn: 奥术投掷器适配新版：支持物品管道接口；模拟提取不会拿走物品，重复查询不会复制物品。
localized.en_us: Arcane Droppers support modern item pipes. Simulated transfers leave items in place and cannot duplicate them.

localized.zh_cn: 魔像秘经
localized.en_us: Gadomancy

localized.zh_cn: 魔灵核心注魔已修正：随机成本在开工时确定并保存，查看预览或重载不会重新抽取。
localized.en_us: Aura Core infusion is fixed: random costs are chosen and saved when work starts; previews and reloads do not reroll them.

localized.zh_cn: 魔像秘经
localized.en_us: Gadomancy

localized.zh_cn: 黏性罐传输已修正：侧放与倒置后，源质接口随罐子朝向转动。
localized.en_us: Sticky Jar transfer is fixed: essentia connections follow the jar when placed sideways or upside down.

localized.zh_cn: 魔像秘经
localized.en_us: Gadomancy

localized.zh_cn: 保护范围已修正：力场只影响所在维度，不再保护其他维度的同坐标区域。
localized.en_us: Protection fields now affect only their own dimension, not matching coordinates in other dimensions.

localized.zh_cn: 魔像秘经
localized.en_us: Gadomancy

localized.zh_cn: 镜像罐网络已修正：满罐也可首次加入供给网络；不同存档的网络不会串联，平衡时遵守标签过滤。
localized.en_us: Mirrored Jar networks are fixed: full jars can join a supply network, saves remain separate, and balancing respects labels.

localized.zh_cn: 魔像秘经
localized.en_us: Gadomancy

localized.zh_cn: 护甲伪装已修正：必须完成研究才能注魔；清洗只返还实际消耗的一件伪装物品。
localized.en_us: Armor Disguise is fixed: infusion requires its research, and cleansing returns only the one disguise item consumed.

localized.zh_cn: 魔像秘经
localized.en_us: Gadomancy

localized.zh_cn: 使魔升级已修正：注魔正确匹配升级颜色，避免误认升级配方。
localized.en_us: Familiar infusion now matches upgrade colours correctly.

localized.zh_cn: 魔像秘经
localized.en_us: Gadomancy

localized.zh_cn: 注魔之爪已修正：使用主人实际掌握的研究；不同设备不再串用位置或知识。
localized.en_us: Infusion Claws use their owner’s actual research. Separate claws no longer share positions or knowledge.

localized.zh_cn: 魔像秘经
localized.en_us: Gadomancy

localized.zh_cn: 灵气效果已修正：光明源质的阻止生成范围只作用于本世界；灵魂护甲选择不会因装备池异常而卡住。
localized.en_us: Aura effects are fixed: Lux spawn protection stays in its world, and Spiritus armour selection cannot hang on an unsuitable equipment pool.

localized.zh_cn: 魔像秘经
localized.en_us: Gadomancy

localized.zh_cn: 源质冷凝器已修正：各部件共用主体的实际容量，满载时拒绝多余源质，避免溢出或复制。
localized.en_us: Essentia Condensers use their main block’s actual capacity and reject excess essentia when full, preventing overflow or duplication.
